reasons.label: Match result
reasons.text: Feyenoord Rotterdam are favoured at 42%, against 35% for FC Porto and 23% for the draw. FC Porto carry 98 more Elo points into the match. Over the last five: Feyenoord Rotterdam 0.6 points per game, FC Porto 1.2. They average 2.0 points per game at home this season.

reasons.label: Goals
reasons.text: The model expects 3.65 goals, which puts it over 2.5 at 71%. Across their last five, Feyenoord Rotterdam and FC Porto have scored 1.3 and conceded 2.1 a game between them.

reasons.label: Self-correction
reasons.text: Adjusted from this competition's own record: goals were predicted 3.11 against 3.63 actual across 182 settled forecasts, so the rate is nudged up 16.9% to stop the model leaning under.

limitations: Only 3 league matches of this season behind the weaker-evidenced side, so form leans on last season.
